name: BaseNative
headline: Apple-grade design, all in code
idea: An open-source design system kit: 47 accessible components on native HTML elements, in light and dark.

points.title: Native HTML elements
points.body: Built on button, dialog, details, table, and the popover API — no virtual DOM.

points.title: Light and dark
points.body: Token-driven components in both color schemes, from 320px phones to desktops.

points.title: AI-safe and agent-ready
points.body: Templates never call eval, running under strict CSP with structured validation and MCP.
